title: Metana
tagline: Metana trains existing developers to be blockchain developers in a 4-month boot-camp program & get them hired.
description: The web3 industry is growing at a 43% CAGR. The Web3 industry is in high demand for blockchain engineers. Web2 engineers want to jump into web3 and get an average of $40k pay raise. But they don’t have the right resources or the pathway to become a blockchain engineer. Companies & founders are desperate to hire skilled developers.
how_its_made: We put together type-A resources from all across the internet to create a pathway. We work with our students throughout the program and after graduation to help them polish their portfolio, practice interviewing, and more to land a job that fits their goals. If a graduate does not get a job, they won't pay Metana a penny.
